description: Breakout fs4/stack4 GaWF L3/L4 LR-decay and 1M/2M replay-buffer sweep
notes: Task 0-4 are L3 hidden_size=605: 1M seeds 1/3 and 2M seeds 1/2/3. Task 5-10 are L4 hidden_size=527: 1M and 2M seeds 1/2/3.
All tasks use Breakout minimal action space, fs4/stack4, GaWF qvalues feedback, 3M steps, checkpoint every 50k steps, and LR 1e-4 through 1M then 1e-5.

Array throttle was raised from 4 to 11 at the user's request. All 11 tasks were observed RUNNING on gpuk018, gpu036, gpu040, gpu042, gpu043, and gpu045. Each task requests one Ada Lovelace GPU, 16 CPUs, 64G memory, AIM3_NUM_WORKERS=12, and AIM3_PIN_MEMORY=1.
Submitted only after five full-replay L3 smoke tasks passed DSSK quota guard and completed 25k steps.
